findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A).

The PIC was unable to show in a verifiable manner that employees are notified of their responsibility to report the reportable symptoms and diagnosis related to foodborne illnesses. A blank copy of the Sangamon County Reporting Agreement given to the facility at the pre-opening was discovered in the facility binder. The PIC was instructed to make copies and have the three stated employees sign it prior the scheduled follow up.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A); or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

A partially used container of sour cream was observed with a date marking of 8/17. This puts the time since opening at 17 days at the time of the inspection. The PIC was shown and discarded the container to correct. The sour cream in the prep cooler was stated as likely being the same batch and did not have a separate date marking during the inspection. It was also discarded during the inspection. Education was conducted. Ensure that any TCS foods are properly date marked and discarded at the end of day seven since opening in the facility.
